status.main_product: Advanced wound dressings and ostomy bags
status.scope_reason: The company develops and sells Caregel, an advanced hydrogel wound dressing product line, under its own brand.
status.evidence: According to the company's product registry on Drogaria São Paulo and its official portal, Vita Medical manufactures and markets the Caregel hydrogel wound dressing line for chronic and acute wound healing.

claims.claim: The Hydrocel AG+ hydrofiber dressing, designed with high-density carboxymethylcellulose fibers and a 1.2% ionic silver concentration to manage wound exudate and provide sustained antimicrobial protection, as reported by Vita Medical.

A 2026 nursing experience report published in the journal Revista Recanto Acadêmico de Extensão e Saúde (REASE) referenced product documentation from Vita Medical regarding advanced wound dressings, using it to help develop a Standard Operating Protocol (POP) for foam dressings in exudative wounds.

The company reports in its official catalog that it maintains international quality management certifications including ISO 9001 and ISO 13485, alongside compliance clearances from the FDA, CE, and TÜV.

The municipal government of Santo Antônio de Posse in the state of São Paulo listed Vita Medical's silver-based antimicrobial dressing product, Aticare AG, as an item reference in its official public healthcare procurement documentation. pncp.gov.br
The company distributes its Caregel amorphous hydrogel wound dressing commercially in the Brazilian retail market, with individual 85g tubes listed for consumer purchase at R$37.00 on Shopee Brasil.

A strategic partnership with GE HealthCare under which Vita Medical is credentialed for the sales and technical assistance of equipment covering respiratory care, maternal-infant care, monitoring, and analgesia solutions, as disclosed on the official Vita Medical Institutional Overview.
